release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.18

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder from 4.0.15 stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice.

OCR has a Run once section. OCR Monitor Pages Now writes a searchable PDF for the pages highlighted in the Assets Manager, or for every loaded page when nothing is highlighted, without setting up a hot folder. One file asks where to save it; several files ask for a folder and write one PDF each. The page count and the log show progress, and when it finishes it offers to add the result to the Assets Manager.

Rotate turns 90 clockwise and -90 counter-clockwise. 180 and 270 apply once from page controls and from the stack. The rotate form shows 90, 180, and 270 as a selection. Crop, Color, Resize, Bleed, and Blank pages have the same page filter as Rotate: All, Odd (front), Even (back), or a page list.

The Assets Manager keeps the highlighted rows after Apply, so a second Apply covers the same pages. Highlighted rows are bold with light text on the selection bar, and every highlighted page carries a box on the monitor: solid on the viewed page, dashed on the others. Page-level edits have their own Remove step and Reset steps; the stack Clear is unchanged. The column next to the stack scrolls with a bar and the mouse wheel when the pane is short.

Changing the theme keeps the asset pages on the monitor and keeps the page highlight, so clicks and Ctrl-clicks on pages still work afterward.

Feedback has an Application data dump. Choosing Bug Report fills the message with a User feedback line, space to type, and the data Cursor needs to see which tools and settings were in use. General Feedback is the default category.

The tool buttons are shorter and pick a column count whose names all fit, so no label spills past its button. The header buttons draw their icon beside the label at the same height.

Labels opens from the header and from the Labels tool and is built into this program. A CSV, XLSX, or ODS file dropped in an automation hot folder runs variable data with the PDF stored in the recipe.
